title: Delta Lake: ACID, Time Travel, Optimize

scenes.line1: How does Delta Lake boost reliability?
scenes.say: Ever wonder how Delta Lake makes data lakes reliable and fast for analytics? Let's break down the magic behind the scenes.

scenes.label: ACID
scenes.sub: ACID transactions keep your data consistent—even with multiple users.
scenes.say: First, Delta Lake supports ACID transactions. That means your data stays consistent, even when many people are updating it at once.
With time travel, you can query previous versions of your data. Perfect for audits or fixing mistakes.

scenes.title: OPTIMIZE & Z-order
scenes.say: OPTIMIZE compacts files for faster queries. Z-order sorts columns, so filtering by user or event type is lightning quick.

scenes.question: Why is ACID important for Delta Lake?
scenes.right: ACID ensures reliable updates and consistency, even with concurrent changes.
scenes.say: Here's a common trap: ACID isn't just about speed. It's about keeping your data reliable, no matter how many updates happen.
